    Dashboard User Manual

    1. Header & period

    Shows the month the data belongs to and the number of active selling days.

    2. Filters

    Use the Region tabs and the BM, State Head and City dropdowns at the top. Every KPI, table and chart updates instantly. Choose “All” to reset. Region-specific files (North / South) are locked to their region.

    3. KPI cards

    Alpha + X-Factor Revenue, Target, Achievement %, and Units Sold (from the Car Counter Count sheet).

    4. Alpha / X-Factor Bifurcation

    Revenue and units split between the Alpha and X-Factor programs.

    5. Model-wise Sales

    Units and revenue for each model (Helping Column in Raw Data).

    6. Achievement Distribution

    Number of reps in each achievement band — red is low, green is on/above target.

    7. Rep Counter & Revenue Coverage

    Per rep: TPS Partner Count, Partners Reported, counter target/achievement, revenue target/achievement and Achievement %.

    8. Revenue Pivot

    Revenue and units by Employee ID × Partner Customer Name × Model. Use the search box to find a rep or counter.

    Tips

    Open on mobile by sharing the HTML file via WhatsApp or email. Scroll tables sideways on small screens. Tap outside this box to close it.
